title: Create the scanner repository and package
description:
As a maintainer, I want DataParade-io/scanner published as @dataparade/scanner, so that the CLI and eval can depend on one package.

Feature: new project

  Scenario: Package exists
    Given the new repository DataParade-io/scanner
    When I install @dataparade/scanner
    Then I can import scan and createDefaultScanConfiguration

Note: Ryan/endymion is admin on DataParade-io and can create this repo. Do not put it inside the dataparade monorepo.
